cells.label: fact

items.text: Merrill launched the Tax Efficient Transition Service (TET), a new service designed to help clients transition appreciated securities into a managed investment strategy over time while managing the realization of capital gains.
items.quote: Merrill today announced the launch of Tax Efficient Transition Service (TET)... TET is a service designed to help clients transition appreciated securities into a managed investment strategy over time.

items.text: Merrill launched the Dollar Cost Averaging Service (DCA), a new service that gradually invests cash into a managed investment strategy according to a client-selected schedule, to help reduce the impact of market volatility.
items.quote: DCA is a service that gradually invests cash into a managed investment strategy according to a client-selected schedule. By investing at regular intervals, the service is designed to help reduce the impact of market volatility.

items.text: Both new services are optional, available through the Merrill Lynch Investment Advisory Program, implemented by Managed Account Advisors LLC, and carry no additional IAP Program Fees.
items.quote: Both services are optional and available to clients, with no additional IAP Program Fees charged. They are available through IAP and are implemented by Managed Account Advisors LLC (MAA).

items.text: Merrill created new data analytics fees for third-party asset managers, costing between $125,000 and $860,000 per-firm, per-year for data on actively managed products (including ETFs, mutual funds, annuities and model portfolios), and between $25,000 and $550,000 for passive ETFs.
items.quote: Merrill's new data analytics fees will cost asset managers between $125,000 and $860,000 per-firm, per-year for data on actively managed products, including ETFs, mutual funds, annuities and model portfolios. Data on passive ETFs managed through Merrill's platforms will cost between $25,000 and $550,000.

items.text: Merrill created a new 'negotiable' revenue-sharing 'support fee' for third-party asset managers, costing up to $1 million per $1 billion of assets managed on behalf of Merrill advisors, ranging from 0.02% on high-net-worth and ultra-high-net-worth assets to a maximum of 0.1% on third-party mutual funds, money market funds and active ETFs.
items.quote: Its new 'negotiable' revenue-sharing 'support fee' will cost up to $1 million, for every $1 billion of funds an asset manager manages on behalf of Merrill advisors, with fees ranging from 0.02% on high-net-worth and ultra-high-net-worth assets, to a maximum 0.1% on third party mutual funds, money market funds, and active ETFs.

items.text: Merrill said third-party firms that pay the new data analytics fees will receive a financial incentive to be made available and recommended over those that do not, effective January 1, 2027.
items.quote: We will have a financial incentive to make available and recommend products from third-party firms that pay fees for data analytics over those that do not... effective, Jan. 1, 2027.

items.text: Merrill's client sales of alternative investments increased 19% in the third quarter of 2026.
items.quote: At Merrill Lynch, client sales of alternative investments increased 19% in the quarter, said Eric Schimpf, president and co-head of Merrill Wealth Management.

items.text: Merrill indicated it would continue to invest in AI and digital capabilities.
items.quote: While the Merrill executive did not mention new AI tools, the message was clear that the firm would continue to invest in AI and digital capabilities.

items.text: Merrill benefited from new AI-enabled tools that help advisers prepare for client conversations, identify opportunities and deliver more personalized advice at scale.
items.quote: Franchise continued to benefit from strong adviser productivity, growing digital engagement and new AI-enabled tools that help advisers prepare for client conversations, identify opportunities and deliver more personalized advice at scale.
